results.text: Transdermal Clonidine for Hypertension: An Underutilized Ally in the Modern Era. Despite advancements in pharmacological strategies, blood pressure (BP) control remains unsatisfactory in a significant proportion of hypertensive patients. This may be related to the multifactorial pathogenesis of hypertension, which makes treatment challenging and often requires the use of multiple BP-lowering pills that can reduce adherence.
